info.title: vetora API
info.description: The API behind the clinic web app and, later, the pet owner app. Routes are declared with zod schemas from packages/contracts.

get.description: Reports the API version and whether the database answers. Used by the web app shell and by uptime checks.

200.description: The API and its database are up

503.description: The database does not answer (problem details)

post.description: Signs a staff member in with `handle@practice-code` and a password and sets the session cookie, which ends 12 hours later. Every refusal of the credentials answers the same 401, whichever part was wrong (story 4). Five failures for one username within 15 minutes lock it for 15 minutes, whether or not a login has it (story 5).

204.description: Signed in: the session cookie is set

401.description: The clinic code, username or password is not right (problem details)

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin (problem details)

429.description: The username is locked (title "Login locked"), or this client sent too many sign ins for now (problem details)

post.description: Ends the session: its row is deleted and its cookie cleared.

401.description: There is no session to end (problem details)

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin (problem details)

get.description: The signed in session and its login, or null. The session token stays in its cookie.

429.description: Too many requests from this client for now (problem details)

get.description: The signed in person, their practice with their roles, and its active locations with the default marked.

403.description: The login has no active practice (problem details)

put.description: Saves the interface language to the login, so it follows the person to any computer.

400.description: Not one of az, ru and en (problem details)

get.description: Every species in its order with its three names, each with its active breeds.

400.description: Validation failed, or no location header or one not of this practice (problem details)

403.description: Not a member, a practice not active, or an action the roles may not perform (problem details)

503.description: The practice is being updated (problem details)

put.description: Adds a breed to a species with one name in the language given. The id is a UUID v7 the client generates: the same request again answers the breed and changes nothing.

403.description: Not a member, a practice not active, or an action the roles may not perform (problem details)

409.description: The species has a breed of this name (problem details)

503.description: The practice is being updated (problem details)

post.description: Every client holding the phone number, written in any common way, each with the patients they own today. A POST, so the number never reaches a URL.

403.description: Not a member, a practice not active, or an action the roles may not perform (problem details)

503.description: The practice is being updated (problem details)

put.summary: Register a client and a patient
put.description: Writes what is new of the client and the patient in one transaction, a new patient's owner row from the practice's today with it. The new ones carry UUID v7 ids the client generates: the same request again changes nothing.

503.description: The practice is being updated (problem details)

put.description: Writes what is new of the client and the patient, then the draft visit, in one transaction: the actor is its veterinarian, the patient's owner its client and reporter, the request's location its place, now its start. The visit id is a UUID v7 the client generates: the same request again changes nothing.

post.description: Completes the visit against the version in If-Match, in one transaction: the actor's care relationship with the patient found and extended, or created, lapsing the practice's lapse months from now; then the visit finalised by the actor, which freezes it. A blank reason for visit is refused.
